assessment: This paper builds a biophysical model to understand the contribution of the DNA sequence in σ70-RNA polymerase binding activity. The authors provide evidence that taking into account that RNA polymerase can bind in multiple configurations, including non-productive ones, significantly improves predictions. They also confirm and extend previous observations that functional promoter sequences are relatively abundant in random sequences. This work represents an important advance to the field, and will hopefully serve as the stepping stone for better models that include transcription factors and eukaryotic enhancers.
